string.text: The medic needs a %s to make medicine on site instead of waiting for supplies. If I find one, I should bring it back.
I can't make medicine here without the right equipment. Help me get it.
There is. Bandages and medkits run out faster than supplies arrive. With a %s I could make them myself, right here. Bring me one and you'll be paid for it, and I'll have more than bandages to sell.
Now that's what I needed. I can finally make proper medicine here. Here's your payment.
